method: breaths by loudness (under -18 dB for 0.3 s, phrases under 1.5 s merged) + text alignment; Whisper: 22 of 28 breaks heard

lines.english: I adore Thee devoutly, O hidden Deity,

lines.latin: Quæ sub his figúris vere látitas:
lines.english: Who under these figures art truly concealed;

lines.latin: Tibi se cor meum totum súbjicit,
lines.english: to Thee my whole heart subjects itself,
for in contemplating Thee it wholly fails.

lines.latin: Visus, tactus, gustus in te fállitur,
lines.english: Sight, touch and taste are deceived in Thee,
but by hearing alone is it safely believed;
I believe whatever the Son of God has said:
nothing is truer than this word of Truth.
On the Cross the Godhead alone lay hidden,

lines.latin: At hic latet simul et humánitas:
lines.english: but here the manhood too lies hidden with it;
yet believing and confessing both,
I ask for what the penitent thief asked.
I do not look upon the wounds, as Thomas did;
yet I confess Thee to be my God;

lines.latin: Fac me tibi semper magis crédere,
lines.english: make me ever more and more believe in Thee,

lines.latin: In te spem habére, te dilígere.
lines.english: have hope in Thee, and love Thee.
O memorial of the death of the Lord,
living Bread that gives life to man,

lines.latin: Præsta meæ menti de te vívere,
lines.english: grant to my mind to live on Thee,

lines.latin: Et te illi semper dulce sápere.
lines.english: and that Thou be ever sweet to its taste.
O loving Pelican, Lord Jesus,
cleanse me, who am unclean, with Thy Blood,
a single drop of which can make safe

lines.latin: Totum mundum quit ab omni scélere.
lines.english: the whole world from every sin.
Jesus, Whom now I look upon veiled,

lines.latin: Oro fiat illud quod tam sítio:
lines.english: I pray that what I so thirst for may come to pass:
that, seeing Thee with Thy face unveiled,
I may be blessed in beholding Thy glory.
Amen.
